content.rendered:
Kaiak is a folk/indie/pop team-up of Swedish musicians Emil Gullhamn and Marcos Ubeda.

Emil and Marcos draw the inspiration for their music from nature, friends, and “really good coffee.”

That description lends itself well to their covers, too, because I can totally dig listening to their version of Bruce’s “Hungry Heart” while taking my morning coffee outside on a lazy weekend morning.

That cover track has been around for a few years, but recently the guys teased us with a thirty-second video to go with it.

There’s no indication whether a full-length version is coming, but we can hope.

© July 5, 2020

excerpt.rendered: Swedish duo Kaiak gives us a groovy acoustic coffee-house rendition of Bruce’s “Hungry Heart.”

jetpack-related-posts.title: Cover Me, River City Extension: Hungry Heart
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Start your morning off with a cool groove: watch River City Extension put their unique spin on Bruce's "Hungry Heart."

jetpack-related-posts.title: Spare Parts: Mike Love and The Beach Boys: Getcha Hungry Heart Back
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: The Beach Boys' 1985 single was an even better "Hungry Heart" cover than Mike Love's direct attempt, and they make for a terrific mash-up.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Bleachers: Hungry Heart
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Jack Antonoff delivered a beautifully poignant cover of Bruce's poppy hit single in a 2017 radio appearance on The Bruce Brunch.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Minnie Driver: Hungry Heart
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Minnie Driver's cover of "Hungry Heart" is more lush and romantic than Bruce's lyrics call for, but then again so was Bruce's original arrangement. Take a listen to her lovely version inside.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Hungry Heart
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Written for The Ramones and influenced by The Byrds, The Four Seasons, and The Beach Boys, "Hungry Heart" gave Bruce his first Top Ten hit.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Cover Me, Divine Fits: Hungry Heart
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: When Britt Daniel of Spoon and Dan Boeckner of Wolf Parade formed Divine Fits, one of the covers they performed together was Bruce Springsteen's "Hungry Heart." Check it out inside.
